num_blackman_gap_lower_relerr.note: relative to the closed-form gap; brentq at xtol 1e-14 on a stationary point, so the error is second order in xtol; measured 1.6e-16

num_blackman_gap_switch_relerr.note: relative to 1/3; exact arithmetic, 1 - 2/3 against 1/3, measured 1.7e-16

num_blackman_Sstar_over_Ks_relerr.note: relative to S*/K_S; brentq's own guarantee xtol + rtol|x| is 2.5e-14 relative here; measured 0

contois_map_mum_relerr.note: relative to the Monod mu_m; two least_squares exits; measured 3.4e-7 to 2.2e-6 across BLAS kernels

contois_map_KS_relerr.note: relative to the Monod K_S; two least_squares exits; measured 3.2e-6 to 1.3e-5 across BLAS kernels, the bound is about 78x the largest

contois_minus_monod_rms.note: one curve fitted twice; two least_squares exits; measured 7.9e-13 to 4.2e-12 across BLAS kernels, the bound is 15x the largest

sep_moser.note: Moser contains Monod at n = 1; least_squares at xtol 1e-13; measured 2.0e-14 to 3.9e-14 across BLAS kernels and above 1e-12 on other machines; 1e-9 is also the degeneracy threshold

sep_contois.note: Contois is Monod under a constant yield; least_squares at xtol 1e-13; measured 2.0e-14 to 6.3e-14 across BLAS kernels; 1e-9 is also the degeneracy threshold

Sf_crossing_vs_a_relerr.note: relative to a; S_f = a identically, the gap is the Contois fit's two exit tolerances (decomposed on the page); measured 4.1e-7 to 1.0e-5 across BLAS kernels, the bound is 50x the largest

rawlings_10_19_max_relerr.note: relative to the closed-form steady state; LSODA at rtol 1e-11 marched to t = 40000; measured exactly 0

pymrm_batch_observed_order.note: backward Euler is first order in dt, and 200/400 steps are in the asymptotic range: 0.9993 measured; the 25/50-step row gives 0.9942

pymrm_batch_conservation_relerr.note: relative to S + X/phi; backward Euler keeps a linear invariant of the source to round-off; measured 4.3e-16 to 1.3e-15 across BLAS kernels, the bound is about 77x that

pymrm_refit_mum_relerr.note: two-route gap, LSODA fit against Richardson-extrapolated backward Euler at 200/400 steps; set by the two fits' stopping rules, measured 1.0e-6 to 1.2e-6 across BLAS kernels; the bound is the prose claim and 1e2 below the 25-step row

pymrm_refit_KS_relerr.note: as for mu_m; measured 2.6e-6 to 7.8e-6 across BLAS kernels; the bound is the prose claim and below the unconverged 25-step refit

pfr_observed_order.note: first-order upwind, asymptotic at 800/1600 cells; outlet from compute_boundary_values, 0.9981 measured; the 100/200 row gives 0.985

pfr_centre_read_order.note: first-order upwind, asymptotic at 800/1600 cells; outlet read at the last cell centre, 0.9957 measured; the 100/200 row gives 0.965

n_separable_alternatives.note: alternatives with a separation above the SEP_BOUND 1/h bound, so that N* is defined: Blackman and Tessier; margin in decades to that bound; decided by the identities, which no row can move
